engine.notes: Detroit's improv lives in the inner suburbs: Go Comedy in Ferndale and Planet Ant in Hamtramck, with Royal Oak's Comedy Castle a stand-up room. The Detroit Creativity Project teaches improv free in schools rather than by public enrolment, so it is not listed. Ann Arbor's Pointless site is gone; hear.say brewing + theater now programmes improv there and hosts the Yes, Ann Improv Fest.

entries.name: Go Comedy! Improv Theater
entries.summary: Ferndale's improv and sketch theatre on East 9 Mile with shows Wednesday to Sunday, resident and house teams, improvised murder mysteries and a Go University class programme whose terms start every two months.
entries.schedule: Fri and Sat 7:30pm and 9:30pm; shorter shows Wed, Thu and Sun; next improv term starts Oct 13, 2026
signals: Intro programme of four classes, then an Advanced long-form programme
New terms about every eight weeks
Kids and teen improv, stand-up and the FTQEE stand-up programme
October 2026 shows and class term posted
entries.reasons: A long-established suburban theatre with shows five nights a week and rolling terms dated to October 2026; the class ladder is two programmes rather than numbered levels.

entries.name: Planet Ant Theatre
entries.summary: Nonprofit theatre at the centre of metro Detroit's comedy community since 1993, running Ant Hall and the Black Box on Caniff Street with Home and Farm improv teams, a 2026 season, Colony Fest and classes in improv, sketch and acting.
entries.schedule: 2026 season and Colony Fest 2026 listed; classes through the Planet Ant Training Center
signals: Ant Hall at 2320 Caniff St plus the Black Box
Home Team and Farm Team improv ensembles
Classes in improv, sketch writing and acting
entries.reasons: Thirty-three years and two rooms of its own with a true farm-to-home-team system, docked because class levels and dates were not readable on the site.

entries.name: hear.say brewing + theater
entries.summary: Ann Arbor microbrewery with an adjacent theater programming improv and stand-up all week, a hear.say academy with improv classes for all levels, team-building workshops and the Yes, Ann Improv Fest.
entries.schedule: Comedy most nights (see calendar); academy term starts September 29; Yes, Ann Improv Fest June 23-26, 2027
signals: Improv and stand-up all week in its own theater
hear.say academy: 8-week improv classes, beginner to advanced
Hosts the Yes, Ann Improv Fest, June 23-26, 2027
entries.reasons: A new brewery-theater that already runs comedy nightly, a levelled academy and a festival, but with little history and class details behind a calendar the site did not expose.
